definition: LiteLLM is an open-source large language model (LLM) gateway developed by BerriAI.
details: It provides a unified OpenAI-compatible application programming interface (API) for accessing and routing requests to different model providers. LiteLLM can be deployed as a self-hosted proxy server or used as a Python library within applications.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is LiteLLM.
